rule: Each figure is an ellipse with horizontal lines and two vertical bars plus a small ellipse and a small square. The ellipse and square swap sides every step (ellipse L,R,L,R so next ellipse L, square R) and both move down one line-band each step (band 5,1,2,3 so next about band 4). The bars are mostly thick, so next is thick.
options_check: 1: ellipse right and square left, wrong sides. 2: thin bars and both marks at bottom, no. 3: ellipse left, square right but square sits at the very bottom end of the right bar, too low. 4: thick bars, ellipse left, square right, square a bit lower than ideal but closest to the pattern. 5: thin bars and both marks low, no.
redraw_diffs: Redraw is roughly faithful in layout. Differences: in the original F1 is a ellipse at bottom-left and square at bottom-right, F2 has bars slightly tilted and thin; the redraw's ellipses and squares are placed at slightly different heights and sizes, and option bar heights and mark positions are approximate. Original options have marks at inexact bands, so the redraw may not preserve which band the marks sit in.
